courses.name: Delaware Springs Golf Course

green_fee.notes: Official rates incl. 1/2 cart: 18 holes Mon-Thu $60, Fri-Sun $75; twilight $41 (Mon-Thu) / $49 (Fri-Sun). 9 holes $41/$49 (after 1pm). $5 off for seniors 60+, juniors, active military, Burnet city residents. Replay $35.

courses.booking_window: 14 days (online public booking range in course's Chronogolf/Lightspeed engine)
courses.notes: City of Burnet course (contact email @cityofburnet.com). Tees 4,749-6,802 yds (Black 6,802). Walking only Mon-Thu and after 1pm Fri-Sun. Par 72 is from the Highland Lakes tourism directory (official site does not state par); architect/opening year not stated on official site.

courses.name: Hidden Falls Golf Club (Meadowlakes)

green_fee.notes: Official daily rates (riding = half cart): 18 holes $48 weekday / $57 weekend & holidays; walking $32/$37; twilight $40/$45; super twilight $38/$43; senior/military/first responder $44/$52; 9 holes $24.

courses.notes: Course of the City of Meadowlakes (gated community; listed as a city department). Public daily-fee play. Site gives 'a 6,700 yards layout' (rounded). Restaurant closed for construction as of read date; overseeding through mid-October.

courses.name: Legends Golf Course & Villas (Legends on Lake LBJ)

green_fee.notes: No rate card published; rates shown only inside the Club Prophet (cps.golf) booking engine. Golf included with villa/cabin stay-and-play.

courses.notes: Official site calls it a public course with on-site villas/cabins. Back-tee yardage is the sum of the 18 gold-tee hole yardages on the official hole-by-hole guide (7,159). Booking window not stated (FAQ says book as early as possible). Opening year not on official site.

courses.name: Lighthouse Country Club (formerly Packsaddle)

green_fee.notes: Site defers to foreUP booking engine. Public-class 18-hole riding prices returned by engine on read date: Wed 7 Oct 2026 $36.71-$55.53; Sat 10 Oct 2026 $42.36-$65.89 (vary by time of day). 9-hole and senior rates also offered.

courses.notes: This is the Kingsland 'Packsaddle' course (renamed after 2011 purchase). Course page: championship tees 6,558 yds; posted scorecard image shows par 71 and 6,485 from back tees. Double-ended range, 10,000 sq ft putting green, chipping green. Coordinates not found in OSM/Nominatim.

courses.name: Llano River Golf Course

green_fee.notes: Official rates: walking $24 Mon-Fri / $29 Sat-Sun; riding $39 / $44. Seniors $14-$31, military $16-$35. Site does not state hole count for the rate table (18-hole course).

courses.notes: City of Llano course next to Robinson City Park on the Llano River. Official homepage states 'Holes: 18 | Par: 71 | Yardage: 7,200' - the 7,200 figure is unusually long and may be a site error (older Highland Lakes directory lists 6,094); verify with course. Coordinates not found in OSM/Nominatim.

courses.name: Hancock Park Golf Course

green_fee.notes: Official fees (tax incl.): weekday green $32, with half cart $52; weekend green $37, with half cart $57; senior/military $29-$54; 9 holes $20 ($30 w/ half cart).

courses.notes: City of Lampasas municipal course (lampasas.org golf page redirects here). Opened 1945 as nine holes, expanded to 18 in 1996. Site says 'just 6,000 yards from the championship tees' (approximate, so yardage left null). Tee times by phone; required weekends/holidays. ~60 miles NW of Austin (borderline distance).

courses.name: Vaaler Creek Golf Club

courses.notes: Public tee times plus memberships for Rockin' J Ranch property owners. Back nine opened July 2007, front nine July 4, 2009 (year_opened = full 18). Gold tees 6,801 (74.1/139) per official scorecard. All green fees include cart.

courses.name: Lady Bird Johnson Golf Course

courses.name: Double J Ranch Golf Club (formerly Quicksand at Woodcreek)
